findings.description: Original criticism retained: finite nonzero vectors accepted under normalization=none can silently produce wrong cosine rankings because math.hypot overflows for huge finite vectors and rounds coarsely for subnormals; float(item) leaks OverflowError for 10**400.
findings.evidence: Source 69e73d648bcad3144a23c82dbbb8847a4fad77f1, apps/prototype-description-service/scripts/eval_harness/semantic_selection_eval.py:98 performed float(item) without conversion handling; :270-272 divided by math.hypot(*vector). Original gate observed scales 1, 1.3e308 and 5e-324 changing top1 from 1 to 0. Current RED independently reproduced 7 wrong-ranking scale pairs, two raw OverflowErrors, and a CLI traceback. GREEN apps/prototype-description-service/scripts/eval_harness/semantic_selection_eval.py:111-116 converts overflow to a field-specific ValueError, wrapped by evaluate_document at :463-466 as SemanticSelectionError; :335-341 divides by max absolute component before norm. apps/prototype-description-service/scene/tests/test_semantic_selection_eval.py:388-435 checks 3x3 independent query/candidate scales, expected scores [1, 1/sqrt(2)], rank, top1/MRR, finite JSON and both numeric owners plus CLI. Legacy-unit mutant caused 7 failures. EMB-01 https://github.com/darce/heuristics-canon/blob/v0.26.2/lexicons/ml-systems.md#emb-01.
